plaatsen.tekst: As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered; so will I seek out my sheep, and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.
So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.
And they put him in ward, because it was not declared what should be done
At the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.
